quest.avas_recovery.notes: 50 Ranged is needed for the accumulator/recovery passive; the quest itself starts at 30. Major permanent account convenience.

quest.devotion.notes: Devotion currently needs only 1 Defence and comes from this F2P quest, not a God Wars drop. 43 Prayer is relevance for the full set of protection prayers, not a quest/ability requirement.

quest.salve.notes: Useful situational equipment; full eligibility rather than an aspiration.

quest.salve_enhanced.notes: 40 Slayer is a real miniquest requirement, not a Slayer training tip. Equipment upgrade stays strict.

quest.piety.notes: 70 Prayer and Defence are Piety use requirements. Knight Waves completion is an additional step; the quest alone does not grant Piety.

quest.trollheim.notes: 61 Magic is the teleport use level, not merely the quest requirement. Destination-specific utility stays strict.

quest.spirit_trees.notes: The quest has no skill requirement. Either travel experience (20 Agility) or an established offensive skill (30) is editorial timing; no invented mandatory combat level. Strict discovery.

quest.house_tablets.notes: Convenient extension rather than a major leveling aspiration. Swan Song remains only its real prerequisite, never a monkfish recommendation.

quest.staff_free_rings.quest: A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift
quest.staff_free_rings.notes: Permanent travel/farming convenience. Weed-free patches require talking to Martin and gardeners after the quest; not an automatic claim that existing weeds vanish.

quest.kingdom.notes: Major ongoing account resource system. Current quest requirements only list The Fremennik Trials; old optional work-task levels are not fabricated as universal gates.

quest.kingdom_expansion.notes: Incremental upgrade to an existing system; strict eligibility.

quest.troll_herb_patch.notes: Single-patch convenience; useful but kept strict rather than encouraging a separate leveling target.

quest.extra_runes.notes: 50 Runecrafting is editorial relevance, not a quest requirement. Modest passive improvement stays strict.

quest.sunspear.notes: Real quest use levels in Attack, Magic and Ranged all remain enforced; not an either/or substitute for the quest requirements.

quest.animate_dead.notes: 84 Magic is Animate Dead use level; no fabricated minimum Defence level. Other spell levels are not claimed to be immediately available.

quest.passive_vigour.notes: The ring requires 62 Attack and Dungeoneering and must still be obtained; the gem consumes it. This is a combat account benefit, not a Dungeoneering tip.

quest.puzzle_box.notes: Tier 5 must already be unlocked to start Succession; final quest opens tier 6. No claim that Succession currently unlocks Dive, which is now naturally available at 30 Agility.

quest.ancient_incantations.notes: 75 Necromancy is the quest minimum, covering Greater Bone Shield at 73. Darkness still needs 86; copy explicitly presents it as a later option. 3,000 vessel souls is non-skill progression, not inferred as met.

quest.bone_shield.notes: 25 Necromancy is Lesser Bone Shield use level. 37 Defence is contextual relevance for the named Reflect ability, not a requirement to toggle Bone Shield. Not an unreachable level-one starter.

quest.elite_dungeon_defence.notes: 75 in an offensive skill is editorial relevance, not a hard dungeon/quest requirement. Reduction is not claimed for Zamorak/ED4. No Dungeoneering training content.

quest.zaros_shard.notes: Situational equipment convenience in the original God Wars Dungeon; strict eligibility.

quest.endgame_skilling.notes: Substantial account-wide skilling bundle; full mandatory quest-chain levels retained. No combat tactics or temporary boost purchases.

quest.fort.notes: 15 Construction is editorial interest/relevance, not a quest start requirement. Beginner facility discovery remains strict.

quest.menaphos.notes: Method use levels are editorial city relevance, not entry requirements. Closest one qualifying skill, not all three, determines aspirations.

quest.arc.notes: Relevant island resource levels are editorial timing, not fabricated quest entry gates. Only one gathering path is needed.

quest.ungael_rituals.notes: 80 Necromancy is actual ritual-site access. Required Grove tier 1 (50 Construction) and Botanist workbench tier 1 (54) are accounted for. Thalmund/tradeable bars do not create an 80 Smithing gate.

quest.menaphos_boons.notes: Major late-game account effects, not XP-lamp/boss-only advice. Full prerequisites, including required Fort buildings, retained.

quest.havenhythe.notes: Substantial region access; no claim that every resource or boss reward is immediately usable at the quest minimums.

quest.asylum_ring.notes: 85 Defence is a wear requirement. All designated replay challenges and an under-37-minute replay are needed; quest completion alone does not award this ring. Strict pre-quest discovery, not an inferred challenge-unlock state.

quest.lunar_utilities.notes: 77 Magic is Superglass Make use; Spellbook Swap remains a later 96 Magic option. The current quest Requirements row has no old 85 combat requirement; use current source, not historical guides.

quest.holy_wrench.notes: Durable utility item, not a consumable XP booster; full eligibility rather than an aspiration.

quest.tokkul_zo.notes: Convenient ring destinations, strict eligibility. No minigame training recommendation.

quest.seren_skilling.notes: The full quest chain and 80 Prayer gate cover the named prayers. Higher-Magic spells are future options, not claimed immediately usable.
